Print a composition-as-predictor summary

Source: R/summary_comp_iv.R
print.summary_comp_iv.Rd

Prints a summary.comp_iv() object as a text report, automatically at the console, as base R's print.summary.lm() does. The report gives the model description, the composition's parts and total (with its unit label, when one was declared) and the omnibus composition test. When the fit carries them, it adds the moderation test, the curvature test, the total-as-covariate test, each grouping term's intraclass correlation or median hazard ratio and any captured backend convergence messages. The effect table follows as plain tibble output, with a closing note when the per-part effects are slopes at the reference composition.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'summary_comp_iv'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A summary_comp_iv object, as returned by summary.comp_iv().

...

Unused; present for S3 consistency.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

summary.comp_iv() to build this object; pub_ready() for a formatted gt table.

Examples

cd <- declare_composition(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"),
                          closure = 1440)
m <- comp_iv(cd, outcome = "obesity", model = "glm", family = "binomial")
print(summary(m))
#> <comp_iv> compositional generalized linear model (binomial)
#>   Parts: MVPA, LPA, SB, SPT (total = 1440)
#>   Omnibus composition test (Wald): chi-squared(3) = 28.922, p = 2.33e-06
#>   Convergence: OK
#> 
#> Compositional effects (Odds ratio)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 6
#>   parameter          label              estimate conf.low conf.high     p.value
#>   <chr>              <chr>                 <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>       <dbl>
#> 1 Global Composition Global Composition   NA       NA        NA     0.00000233 
#> 2 MVPA vs remaining  MVPA                  0.501    0.382     0.656 0.000000489
#> 3 LPA vs remaining   LPA                   0.982    0.506     1.91  0.958      
#> 4 SB vs remaining    SB                    2.98     1.16      7.65  0.0234     
#> 5 SPT vs remaining   SPT                   0.683    0.273     1.71  0.415
